name: agent-plans
description: Repo-agnostic planning conventions for coding agents.

plugins.name: plans-lifecycle
plugins.description: A lifecycle convention for plan documents: docs/plans/{ideas,ready,ongoing} to docs/decisions. One file per topic, moved between folders as the work matures, deleted once the code is the source of truth. Pure convention: no scripts, no config, no tooling assumptions. Ships an optional bridge skill for repos that also use superpowers.
